verdicts.strongest_argument: The individual filings are all in filings.json, so this is reachable rather than hidden, and what the finding adds on top -- monthly density -- is the part that does not survive. Braze is 92% above its 52-week low (baselines/BRZE.json tape.pct_from_52w_low = 91.96) and ran 27.95 (08-17) to 34.53 (08-28), +23.5% in nine sessions, with a +10.6% single day on 08-27 on 3.15m shares. Form 144 notices are per-seller and per-plan, so eleven notices from a company with five separate multi-holder vest batches in the prior year (7 on 2026-02-02, 6 on 2026-02-20, 7 on 2026-03-20, 7 on 2026-05-19) is the arithmetic of 10b5-1 limit orders being filled by a 23% rally, not a decision. The hunter's own note concedes the point twice: the fiscal Q2 ended 31 July so late-August discretionary sales would sit in blackout, meaning these are pre-set dispositions, and the entire move has already been surrendered -- 34.53 on 08-28 to 30.31 on 09-08, -12.2%, with run_up_5d_pct of -10.96% in the sealed baseline. If insider supply were the operative fact it has already been absorbed in the bars I am allowed to read. Against a $3bn-plus market cap and 2.73m average daily volume, eleven 144 notices is a rounding error of float, and no mechanism connects them to the Q2 result being reported. What keeps this off the 20-40 band is only that no captured item ties the filings to the print -- but the corpus has zero news items for BRZE in any sweep, which is a capture artefact, so silence there is worth nothing in either direction.

prior_publication.what_it_says: The eleven Form 144 notices and thirteen Form 4s are indexed in the same EDGAR feed the capture stored, publicly available on their filing dates; the density is computable by anyone reading the index.

Barclays raised its target to $38 from $31 on 2026-09-03, i.e. sell-side was marking the name up inside the same window, which is the opposite read and is the only published commentary in the capture.

verdicts.baseline_evidence: quote.json (amc name, so the 2026-09-08 close of 30.31 is pre-print and admissible): 27.95 on 08-17 to 34.53 on 08-28 (+23.5%), then 34.04 / 32.78 / 32.94 / 33.25 / 30.31 into the print. Volume on the 08-24 and 08-27 selling dates was 6.21m and 3.15m against a 2.73m 20d average, i.e. the days the notices cluster are the days with enough liquidity to absorb them. realised_vol_20d 62.9% and median absolute reaction 11.64% dwarf any float effect this could have.
verdicts.what_would_change_it: A Form 4 showing a non-10b5-1 open-market sale by an officer with knowledge of the quarter, or 144 notional large enough to be a material fraction of the 2.73m daily volume rather than scattered vest-and-sell.
